tokens.name: bg-grouped
tokens.usage: Screen background behind grouped lists and grids.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list cells, search field. Depth comes from this step against bg-grouped, never from shadows.

tokens.name: bg-fill
tokens.usage: Search field and segmented-control track.

tokens.name: scan-ground
tokens.usage: Placeholder behind a thumbnail while it loads. Scans themselves stay paper-white in both themes.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, names, body text.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Counts, dates, supporting lines.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Days left when not soon, placeholders, disabled text.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows, inset to the text.

tokens.name: chevron
tokens.usage: Disclosure chevrons on navigation rows. Never on buttons.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Graphite interface tint: buttons, links, toolbar items, at weight 600. Hue is reserved for collections and expiry.

tokens.name: coll-wallet
tokens.usage: Wallet. Identifies the collection only: its dot, its folder, its suggestion chip.

tokens.name: coll-receipts
tokens.usage: Receipts. Identifies the collection only.

tokens.name: coll-notes
tokens.usage: Notes. Identifies the collection only.

tokens.name: coll-documents
tokens.usage: Documents. Identifies the collection only.

tokens.name: coll-throwaways
tokens.usage: Throwaways. Identifies the collection only.

tokens.name: badge-wallet
tokens.usage: Round badge behind the white wallet symbol on Home rows and details. The deep colour in both themes so the white symbol keeps 3:1.

tokens.name: badge-receipts
tokens.usage: Round badge behind the white receipts symbol on Home rows and details. The deep colour in both themes so the white symbol keeps 3:1.

tokens.name: badge-notes
tokens.usage: Round badge behind the white notes symbol on Home rows and details. The deep colour in both themes so the white symbol keeps 3:1.

tokens.name: badge-documents
tokens.usage: Round badge behind the white documents symbol on Home rows and details. The deep colour in both themes so the white symbol keeps 3:1.

tokens.name: badge-throwaways
tokens.usage: Round badge behind the white throwaways symbol on Home rows and details. The deep colour in both themes so the white symbol keeps 3:1.

tokens.name: expiry-soon
tokens.usage: The one expiry signal: days left when 7 or fewer, at weight 600. Nothing else uses it. Light value darkened from #b4540f for 4.5:1 contrast.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete now and Empty Trash only, in menus and confirmation sheets.

tokens.name: badge-neutral
tokens.usage: Badge behind Recent, All Scans and Trash symbols.

tokens.usage: Scan button, chips, search field.
